projects.title: Standup Tracker
projects.description: Full-stack platform to automate daily standups by extracting GitHub commits and PRs into structured reports. 5-agent AI scoring pipeline using Groq (Llama 3) under 2 seconds.

projects.title: Distributed Flash Sale System
projects.description: High-concurrency backend for 100k+ peak users with sub-200ms latency. Redis Lua atomic inventory, Kafka async pipeline, Saga pattern rollbacks, and virtual waiting rooms.

projects.title: Vistagram
projects.description: Microservices-based social media platform with modular auth, feeds, media, and notifications. Deployed with Docker and Kubernetes.

projects.title: DriftBox
projects.description: 5-service microservices cloud storage with NGINX gateway, SHA-256 chunk-based uploads via MinIO, versioned metadata in PostgreSQL, and real-time sync via RabbitMQ and WebSockets.
